items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: His lead guitarist’s favorite guitarist was Django Reinhardt.

ctx.x: When you go home are you a person who puts on music?

Well what happens, I’ll lead into that with something Merle Haggard told me. Haggard knows an enormous amount about jazz and when he has the right audience he plays it. He had an alto sax player once who was a jazz player, who could also play country. His lead guitarist’s favorite guitarist was Django Reinhardt. And when I interviewed Haggard he mentioned some New Orleans players that I never heard of before, I was embarrassed. I went home and looked them up. But I think he’s sort of bipolar. And he said to me…
That’s a great answer, it sort of anticipates my next question because I know we have to wrap up soon, but how do you get up for every day, of what you do.
